text_block_list.text: One day, as I was passing by the park—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Taiki-senpai, how does it taste~?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it had good taste!
Though it was a biiit bitter!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know what to say at times like this!
Kekkou na otemae de~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I'm so glad to hear you say that~♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer.
I was just about to have an open-air tea ceremony with Taiki-senpai~.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, outdoor tea party!!!
It is sooo much fuuun!!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right!
I bought some donuts!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
As long as we have that, bitter tea is
no problem at all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll go get it right aw—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeyaaaaaaahhh!!!
Ohhhhh myyyy goooooddd!!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hornet! It's a hornet!
NOOOOOOO~~~~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Looks like... bees.
I wonder if they were lured in by the smell of the donuts.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Help! Grass, heeeeeeelllp!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please leave it to me.
This part is—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please leave it to me.
This part is—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's true. They say it's best not to agitate bees
and just stay still—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... If we stop moving,
will we be safe?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's completely safe.
So please calm down, Taiki-senpai, okay?

Doing as Grass Wonder said,
I stayed still on the spot for a while, and then—
(Bzzz...)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh...! Graaass!
We're saved~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... In America, we're taught from when we're children
that killer bees are dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Bees gather in bright places,
so why don't we move over to that shade~?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
O-Okay. Then just like in a race,
we dash right at the start—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, Taiki-senpai.
You have to move slowly so the bee doesn't notice you."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
Could that possibly be... a ninja?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That's right~ This is your chance to become a ninja,
Taiki-senpai. So let's do our best♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Ninja Taiki Shuttle,
makes a slow start!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Slowly, quietly...

And so, the three of us evacuated
to a safe place.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —Phew. Looks like everything is fine now.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... In America, we're taught from when we're children
that killer bees are dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Dat's why it was so scary!
I still can't stop shaking, you knowww...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
There are accidents involving bees over there too,
so lots of girls don't like them, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's-a true! Grass's approach
was absolutely perfect! Wonderfu~l!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
If it looked that way to you, then that's what matters most♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Know your enemy and know yourself, and you will not be imperiled in a hundred battles."
It's precisely because she's a terrifying opponent that I studied her inside and out to counter her.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
As long as you know the countermeasure and put it into practice,
there's nothing to be afraid of~.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh... As expected of you, Grass!
Kekko na otemae de~!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...That's not quite right~.

It was an early afternoon where I came to realize
Grass Wonder's unshakeable strength.
